name: Wakamiya Yuri
source:
Headmistress of Tengoku Jogakuen. The original founder was her father. She has a politician husband, and she herself has connections with the media and lawmakers. 

Although she is the true head of the association, she seldom opens herself to the members of the Diet. Despite her demure face and her coercive manner which is similar to Reiko, she is masochist, a secret that even her husband does not know.

She comes from a well-known family. She married her husband because their interests matched, not out of love.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=213461&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
